about: Chile's national population censuses and the official INE sources FactSync Chile cites. Used to check which census a figure is attributed to. Compiled by FactSync Chile in October 2026 from INE's census history and the Spanish and English Wikipedia articles on each census.

discredited.2012: Carried out in 2012 and published in April 2013, but its results were later withdrawn: INE discarded the data because of problems in collecting and processing it, and a new census was carried out in 2017. Figures attributed to it are not official.
